Sandbox_DynamicTrading.RarityBonus_toolt: Increases or decreases the likelihood of rare items appearing. Positive values make rare loot more common.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.RestockInterval_t: How many days must pass before a trader refreshes their inventory.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.ScanCooldown_tool: Real-time minutes a player must wait between scanning attempts.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.ScanPenaltyPerTra: Reduces scan chance based on how many traders have already been found today. Higher = Harder to find the last few traders.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.SeasonImpact_tool: How strongly seasons affect prices (e.g. Winter making food expensive).
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.CategoryInflation: How fast prices rise when players buy out a specific category (Supply & Demand).
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.TraderStayHoursMi: Minimum in-game hours a trader stays connected before leaving.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.TraderStayHoursMa: Maximum in-game hours a trader stays connected before leaving.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.PublicNetwork_too: If enabled, radio scan results (Success/Failure) are shown to ALL players on the server. If disabled, only the scanning player sees the result.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.WalletMinCash_too: The minimum amount of money found in a wallet (if not empty).
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.WalletMaxCash_too: The maximum amount of money found in a normal wallet. Jackpots can exceed this.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.WalletEmptyChance: Percentage chance a wallet contains nothing but junk.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.WalletJackpotChan: Chance to hit the 'Tax Return' tier, granting max cash + bonus.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.FactionStartPop_t: Initial number of members in a generated faction.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.FactionDailyConsu: Multiplier for daily food/meds consumption. Higher = Harder for factions to survive.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.FactionGrowthChan: Daily chance for a stable faction to recruit a new member (if recruits are available).
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.GlobalRecruitCoun: Total number of new wanderers available for all factions to recruit each day.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.FactionDeathThres: How many days a faction can go without food before members start dying rapidly.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.MaxFactionsPerTow: The maximum number of distinct factions that can exist in a single town at once.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.FactionRespawnCha: Daily chance for a new faction to arrive in a town if the number of existing factions is below the limit.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.IndependentSpawnR: The minimum tile distance from an active player that an Independent (Nomadic) or wandering trader can spawn.
The maximum tile distance from an active player that an Independent (Nomadic) or wandering trader can spawn.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.TownTraderWanderC: The percentage chance that a town-based trader will decide to wander out of their home town and spawn near an active player instead.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.NPCWeaponDurabili: If enabled, only player-roster NPCs consume weapon durability in combat. World NPCs never use this mechanic.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.NPCBaseHealthMult: Scales the archetype base HP used by DT NPC custom health. 1.0 = default values, 2.0 = double base HP before skill bonuses.
